name: Nubra to Hanle: The Long Way Round
description: A longer high-altitude proposal, with permissions and suitability at the centre.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Leh
itinerary.description: Meet your arranged transfer and settle into your stay. Keep the day flexible around arrival and rest.

itinerary.title: A second gentle day
itinerary.description: Keep a further easy day for rest and acclimatisation. Short local outings are optional and depend on individual wellbeing and professional advice.

itinerary.title: Monasteries & the Indus
itinerary.description: Consider a relaxed cultural circuit near Leh. Confirm the specific sights, opening times, and transport arrangements before departure.

itinerary.title: Across to Nubra
itinerary.description: Travel to Nubra only when wellbeing, road access, and permissions allow. The day’s stops and pace remain flexible.

itinerary.title: A village day in Nubra
itinerary.description: Explore village surroundings and discuss an optional Turtuk excursion. Confirm access requirements and the day’s driving plan.

itinerary.title: Lake horizons
itinerary.description: Continue towards Pangong on a suitable confirmed route. A high-altitude overnight is optional; an alternative stay may be necessary for your group.

itinerary.title: Towards Hanle
itinerary.description: Proceed towards Hanle only if nationality-specific permissions, route access, and wellbeing allow. Astronomical-site access and stargazing are not guaranteed.

itinerary.title: Return to Leh
itinerary.description: Return to Leh and keep the rest of the day free. Leave contingency time for weather and road disruptions.

itinerary.title: Until next time
itinerary.description: Check out and take the arranged transfer for your onward journey. Departure timings and road buffers will be confirmed in your proposal.
